title: Cancellation Policy
seoDescription: Cancellation terms for direct Golden Bay holiday home bookings, including refunds 14 days before check-in and how to change or cancel your holiday stay.
intro: These terms apply to direct bookings made through Golden Bay Holiday Homes. OTA bookings follow the cancellation policy shown on that platform.

rules.heading: 14 days or more before check-in
rules.body: Full refund of the accommodation total (excluding non-refundable fees if stated on your confirmation).

rules.heading: Within 14 days of check-in
rules.body: 50% of the accommodation total is retained.

rules.heading: How to cancel
rules.body: Email admin@gbholidayhomes.co.nz or call us with your booking reference as soon as you know you need to change plans.
